values.ebece0e7-cad5-40e3-89d4-049ab638324d: Collector of rare things. Wants the Jade Monkey back.

values.b53e653a-c7e6-474b-948c-e71aaa7ec59e: A flat above a laundrette. Smells of fabric softener.

values.81aaaf9a-dd67-41e5-906b-b40b399e78e4: A small jade statue. Priceless, and slightly smug-looking.
Shows the air vent above the Grand Gallery.

values.ebece0e7-cad5-40e3-89d4-049ab638324d: Driver. Gentle giant. Hates loud noises.

values.b53e653a-c7e6-474b-948c-e71aaa7ec59e: Pigeons, skylights and a very good view.
Painted to look like a flower delivery.

values.ebece0e7-cad5-40e3-89d4-049ab638324d: Hacker. Can open anything with a keypad.

values.81aaaf9a-dd67-41e5-906b-b40b399e78e4: Bruno's grandmother's. Do not lose them.

values.b53e653a-c7e6-474b-948c-e71aaa7ec59e: Marble, moonlight, and one jade monkey on a plinth.

values.ebece0e7-cad5-40e3-89d4-049ab638324d: Night guard. Owns a very nosy cat called Biscuit.

data.label: Get ready
data.note: Each option has a Requires, so it disappears once done. The jumps loop back here.

data.text: The guard has a cat, apparently. One packet of salmon treats, please.
Already done. There’s an air vent right above the Grand Gallery.
…Yeah. Yeah! Easy!

data.note: You need both the blueprints and the lockpicks to leave.

data.text: Seatbelts, everyone. Next stop: the museum roof.
Grandma’s set. Bring them back, or she’ll find you. She always finds you.
Without the blueprints and the lockpicks? Bold. Also no.
Juni, can you get us into the museum’s plans?
Leave it with us, Madame Vex.
Okay. You’re officially my favourite criminal.
Flat white, extra shot. You’ve earned it.
Bruno. Best driver in the city. Tonight is going to be easy.
Bruno, we’ll need your lockpicks.
Right. Everyone in the van.
The Jade Monkey was mine before the museum "found" it. Bring it back by dawn, and you never pay rent again.

data.note: Only offered with 4+ coins. With 5 to start, buying treats or coffee in The Plan makes this unaffordable.
data.text: Gustav. Wake up. Fancy a very long tea break?
Got it. Everyone out. Now.
The vent’s exactly where the blueprints said. In we go.
Biscuit yowls. Gustav snorts in his sleep. Somewhere, a light blinks red.

data.note: The bluff only works if Juni trusts you enough to play along. Buying her a coffee in The Plan helps.

data.text: Oh! Right. Mind Biscuit, she bites.
Tea break. Twenty minutes. I saw nothing. Biscuit saw nothing.
Pest control? At midnight? I’m calling my supervisor.
Biscuit pounces on the treat and forgets you exist. Silent as a shadow.

data.menuText: Roll a cat treat across the floor
data.text: Here, Biscuit. Salmon. Your favourite.
The Grand Gallery. Gustav dozes in a chair. His cat, Biscuit, sits on the plinth beside the Jade Monkey, staring at you.
Evening! Pest control. We had reports of a… monkey.
The museum roof. Pigeons. A skylight. Somewhere below, a cat is purring.
Easy… easy…

data.note: Advancing to Midnight runs “The midnight patrol”: any alarm at all gets worse.

data.text: Very dangerous monkey. We’ll take it from here, sir.
I can’t, I can’t, I CAN’T—
A deal’s a deal.
Not a single siren. We’re ghosts.
CAUGHT. The van stalls outside the museum. Biscuit watches from the window, deeply satisfied.

data.note: Only offered with 2+ coins: a guaranteed escape.
data.text: Two coins. Deluxe wax, and take your time.
The Jade Monkey. Hand it over, darling, and the rent is gone forever.

data.note: Bruno’s nerve decides the chase. A pep talk in The Plan helps.

data.text: There’s a car wash on the corner. For a couple of coins they’ll hide us in the tunnel.
Hold on to something! Left, right, through the car wash… and we’re clear!
CLOSE SHAVE. The van smells of soap and victory. You deliver the Jade Monkey at sunrise.
Sirens! Why is it always sirens?
HIDDEN IN PLAIN SUDS. The police roar past the car wash. You stroll out at dawn, very clean, Jade Monkey in hand.

data.note: Only offered if Gustav fell for the bluff.
data.text: Actually… the museum is free on Sundays. Everyone should get to see it.
CLEAN GETAWAY. No rent, ever again. Bruno buys everyone pancakes.

data.note: Three or more alarm points and the sirens start.

data.text: No time. Floor it!
ROBIN HOOD. The Jade Monkey is back on its plinth by Monday. Gustav swears he saw Biscuit wink.

meta.description: A crew plans a heist to win back the Jade Monkey. Shows templates, items, character state, relationships, world variables, time phases with rules, requirements that hide used options or lock what you can’t afford, a coin budget shown in Play, loops, and five endings across three flows. Play 1 · The Plan, then 2 · The Heist, then 3 · The Getaway.
